matter_background.original: Athula Silva is a Notary practicing in Colombo. His client Mr. Siripala wishes to take on lease a business premises situated in Kegalle for his textile business belonging to one Mr. Kariyawasam. Mr. Kariyawasam wants Mr. Godage his Notary who is authorized to practice in Kegalle to draft and attest the lease agreement. Mr. Siripala is not willing to come to Kegalle.

1). Athula Silva is a Notary practicing in Colombo. His client Mr. Siripala wishes to take on
lease a business premises situated in Kegalle for his textile business belonging to one
Mr. Kariyawasam. Mr. Kariyawasam wants Mr. Godage his Notary who is authorized
to practice in Kegalle to draft and attest the lease agreement. Mr. Siripala is not willing
to come to Kegalle. How can they execute this Agreement?
